title: FDA Form 5067 cosmetic product listing fields

source.title: FDA Form FDA 5067 - Cosmetic Product Listing

rules.failure: Provide the responsible person's name as it appears on the product label.
Provide the responsible person's contact phone number, including country or area code.
Provide one or more cosmetic product category codes.
Provide the product name or statement of identity as it appears on the label.
Identify whether the product contains fragrance and/or flavor.
List the FEI for each manufacturing or processing facility, or confirm the exemption and provide facility name/address where applicable.
List product ingredients by the required or common/usual name.
Identify at least one product for every listed ingredient.
